title: Marketplace System Map
description: Interactive map of marketplace models, listing/bid flows, escrow bridge, and capabilities. Pan, zoom, and click nodes for details.

help.title: About Marketplace System Map
help.overview: This map is a living diagram of the marketplace module: models, how money and work move, and what the product can do. It does not change data — it explains the domain so operators and builders share the same picture.

sections.title: The three tabs
items: Model graph — entities and how they reference each other (listings, orders, bids, escrow, and so on).
How it works — flows such as listing → order, task request → bid → award, and dispute / escrow outcomes.
Capabilities — what the module supports today at a product level.

sections.title: How to read it
items: Pan and zoom the canvas. Click a node for a short description.
Use it when onboarding staff, designing permissions, or deciding where a new feature should live.
Operational work still happens on the list pages under Marketplace (listings, orders, disputes, and the rest).
